faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Here are some quick answers to help you understand how Atmos powers your productivity.

items.question: Is Atmos free and open source?
items.answer: Yes. Atmos is fully open source under the MIT license. You can download it for free, self-host it, or build from source.

items.question: Will I lose my terminal sessions if my computer crashes?
items.answer: No. All terminal sessions are backed by tmux and persist independently of Atmos. If your computer crashes, the Atmos app crashes, or you close it, your sessions keep running and can be reattached when you return.

items.question: Can multiple agents work in parallel?
items.answer: Yes. Atmos uses Git worktree isolation to give each agent its own independent workspace. Multiple agents can run side-by-side without interfering with each other's file changes.
